hints.title: Copy nodes before copying edges
hints.body: An edge cannot point to a copied node that does not exist yet. Create a copy of every node first, or create copies lazily while traversing.

hints.title: Map original to copy
hints.body: Use a dictionary or map from an original node's label to its copy. The map prevents creating two copies for the same original node when it is reached along different edges.

hints.title: Traverse every component
hints.body: A depth-first traversal from one node only covers its connected component. Start a traversal from every node, or iterate over all nodes after building the map, so disconnected components are copied too.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
create an original node for each index, with the given neighbors
copies = empty map from label to copied node

clone(node):
    if node.label in copies: return copies[node.label]
    copy = new node with node.label
    copies[node.label] = copy
    for neighbor in node.neighbors:
        copy.neighbors.push(clone(neighbor))
    return copy

for every original node:
    clone(node)

result = []
for label from 1 to n:
    result.push(sorted labels of copies[label].neighbors)
return result
```
